jobs.title: ArcGIS/Geospatial Specialist
jobs.description:
Ardent is seeking an ArcGIS/Geospatial Specialist to join our team.

This is a remote position.

**Position Description:**

Ardent is seeking an ArcGIS/Geospatial Specialist to support enterprise geospatial systems, platform operations, and modernization initiatives in a federal government environment.

The ArcGIS/Geospatial Specialist will be responsible for administering, maintaining, and optimizing ArcGIS Enterprise environments, supporting platform upgrades, automating geospatial workflows, and ensuring the reliability and performance of enterprise GIS services. This role will collaborate with technical teams to support geospatial infrastructure modernization, system monitoring, and cloud architecture assessments.

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Administer, configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot ArcGIS Enterprise environments, geospatial services, datasets, and integrations.
* Automate ArcGIS service publication and data refresh workflows across integration, certification, and production environments.
* Plan, test, execute, and document ArcGIS Enterprise upgrades, including compatibility testing, rollback planning, and post-upgrade validation.
* Deploy, configure, and maintain geospatial administration tools, including GeoJobe Admin Tools and CleanMyOrg.
* Perform ArcGIS Server load testing, performance tuning, capacity planning, scaling optimization, and resource right-sizing.
* Support ArcGIS service-health dashboards, system monitoring, and integration with enterprise observability tools.
* Contribute to assessments and modernization planning for ArcGIS Enterprise on Amazon EKS, including architecture, cost, security, operational risks, and migration considerations.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, development, and geospatial teams to support system reliability and operational improvements.
* Maintain technical documentation, performance metrics, and change-management records.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Information Technology, Geography, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in GIS systems administration, geospatial engineering, or closely related technical roles.
* Experience administering and supporting Esri ArcGIS Enterprise environments, including ArcGIS Server.
* Experience configuring, publishing, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise GIS services and datasets.
* Experience automating geospatial workflows, service publication, or data management processes.
* Experience supporting ArcGIS Enterprise upgrades, system maintenance, and compatibility testing.
* Knowledge of enterprise GIS architecture, system integrations, and infrastructure dependencies.
* Experience monitoring and troubleshooting GIS platform performance, availability, and operational issues.
* Familiarity with scripting or automation technologies used in enterprise GIS environments.
* Experience developing technical documentation and supporting established change-management procedures.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting GIS systems within federal government or other large enterprise environments.
* Experience with Python, ArcPy, or ArcGIS API for Python. Experience with GeoJobe Admin Tools, CleanMyOrg, or similar GIS administration utilities.
* Experience with ArcGIS Monitor, service-health dashboards, or enterprise monitoring solutions.
* Experience with ArcGIS Server load testing, performance optimization, and capacity planning. Familiarity with AWS, Amazon EKS, Kubernetes, or cloud-hosted GIS infrastructure.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines or automated GIS service deployment.
* Knowledge of federal IT security standards and change-management requirements.
* Relevant Esri or cloud technology certifications.

Due to the nature of the work we support, all candidates in consideration for this role must be willing to undergo the government issued background investigation process. We highly encourage all Veterans and those with disabilities to apply.

Ardent is an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, upgrading, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the bases of race, color, gender, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran's status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other basis protected by state, local, or federal law.

jobs.title: Electrical T&D Inspector UAV Pilot
jobs.description:
Acuren’s strength begins with its people. Guided by our values—**People First, Integrity Always, One Team, Higher Standards, and Innovative** —we work to create safe, respectful, and high-performing environments for our employees, clients, and communities.

We are honored that our people have recognized Acuren as worthy of inclusion in the *Forbes* 2024 and 2025 list of Canada’s Best Employers. This recognition reflects the importance we place on investing in our people, protecting everyone we work with, and acting with integrity in every engagement.

Acuren delivers comprehensive inspection, testing, certification, and asset integrity solutions that help organizations ensure critical assets are safe, compliant, and optimized for reliable performance. Our specialized expertise and advanced capabilities support clients across energy, industrial, and public infrastructure sectors.

Our services include inspection; traditional and advanced NDE/NDT; failure analysis; rope access; materials, field, and reliability engineering; drones; robotics; V-Deck; and condition-based monitoring. Through these capabilities, we help clients evaluate asset condition, manage operational risk, and make informed decisions throughout the asset lifecycle.

Our work supports the integrity and safety of assets across petroleum refining, pipelines, power generation, pulp and paper, mining, pharmaceutical, aerospace, and automotive industries. Acuren employs more than 5,000 professionals who support mechanical integrity and inspection programs across industrial sectors.

Our approach is practical and focused: provide capable local teams with certified, well-equipped personnel supported by trained and experienced leaders. Building on a strong heritage of safety, quality, and professionalism, we continue to advance technical capabilities and support reliability programs that create value for clients and employees.

Accessibility accommodations are available to applicants upon request. The company uses AI-enabled tools to organize candidate responses; these tools may be used during the screening or assessment process.

  

* Conduct visual and structural inspections of poles, crossarms, insulators, transformers, conductors, and related components on transmission and distribution circuits.
* Identify and document defects, clearance violations, deterioration, and non-conforming installation.
* Record condition data accurately using company inspection software and mobile data collection tools
* Verify equipment tagging, pole numbering, and asset location accuracy using GPS and GIS tools.
* Perform ground-based and UAS inspections in accordance with inspection standards.
* Ensure all work complies with CPUC General Orders 95 and 165, company procedures, and client specifications.
* Collaborate with managers, safety teams, and QA/QC personnel to ensure high-quality inspection data.
* Participate in daily tailboards, safety briefings, and job hazard analyses.
* Comply with all company, client, and regulatory safety requirements, including GO 165 standards for periodic inspection.
* Conduct Job Safety Analyses (JSA) and participate in daily safety tailboards
* Identify and report safety hazards, environmental issues, and near-miss incidents.
* Maintain personal protective equipment (PPE) and climbing gear in proper condition.
* Promote a “Safety First” mindset across all inspection and field activities.

Other work duties as assigned.

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:**

* Ability to read and interpret maps, drawings, and construction standards.
* Proficient in mobile inspection and GIS-based data systems.
* Ability to perform physically demanding fieldwork in various terrain and weather conditions.

**EDUCATION:**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in electrical utility field inspection, line work, or maintenance.
* Working knowledge of CPUC GO 95 (Overhead Line Construction Rules) and GO 165 (Inspection and Maintenance Standards).
* Understanding of distribution and transmission system configurations and hardware components.
* Valid FAA Remote Pilot Certificate (Part 107) or equivalent regulatory certification for commercial UAS
* Valid driver’s license and ability to travel within assigned areas.

jobs.title: Geospatial & Software Data Developer
jobs.description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

**Role description:**

Arcadis is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Geospatial & Software Data Developer to join our data-driven engineering and design team. This role focuses on building, maintaining, and scaling custom software tools, geospatial applications, and data-driven workflows for architecture, urban design, planning, and engineering projects.

We work on a broad range of local and international projects for both public and private sector clients. This position is ideal for a candidate with strong software engineering fundamentals, expertise in spatial data systems, and a solid understanding of data science algorithms who can translate complex design and spatial requirements into reliable computational solutions.

Our team offers flexibility regarding location. The successful candidate will have the option to work from any of our offices throughout the United States or remotely.

**Role accountabilities:**

* Design, build, test, and maintain robust custom software applications, plugins, and internal platforms for diverse engineering and spatial design purposes

* Build, maintain and improve computational workflows and products across the firm

* Engineer seamless data pipelines across varied environments, including GIS platforms, 3D/BIM modeling software, cloud infrastructure, and modern software development toolchains

* Apply data science methodologies, statistical modeling, and machine learning/deep learning algorithms to extract insights from complex spatial, environmental, economic, and demographic datasets

* Continuously maintain, refactor, and improve existing computational workflows, codebase repositories, and data processing architectures

* Clearly communicate complex algorithmic and software concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences using written documentation, technical reports, and visual diagrams

* Collaborate with internal and external clients to understand their needs and develop strategies

* Stay up to date with advances in software engineering, modern GIS frameworks, spatial analytics, and AI/ML applications to keep company workflows cutting-edge

* Create presentation and report materials to support projects

* Build quality relationships with team members and across the organization

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Software Engineering, Architecture, Computational Design, Digital Media or related fields (Master’s Degree preferred)

* Strong proficiency in **Python** (e.g., FastAPI, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and **JavaScript/TypeScript** (e.g., Node.js, React, or modern web mapping frameworks)

* Experience designing and querying relational/spatial databases (e.g., PostgreSQL/PostGIS) and building ETL/ELT pipelines for complex datasets

* 3+ years of relevant experience in building and maintaining large scale data processing and predictive systems. Knowledge in data mining and analytics methods such as regression, classifiers, machine learning and deep learning algorithms

* Formulate open research problems at the intersection of GenAI, multimodal reasoning, and large-scale information retrieval defining the scientific questions that transform ambiguous, real-world catalog challenges into publishable, high-impact research

* Practical experience or research interest in GenAI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or AI tools applied to software engineering workflows

* Stay up to date with the research literature and product advances in AI for software engineering

* Ability to deliver in challenging project timeframes and deadlines

* Excellent verbal, written, and graphic communication skills

* Collaborate across disciplines with teams across organization

* Critical thinking skills to develop innovative solutions

**Additional Information:**

We request applicants submit a portfolio/Website or GitHub link highlighting relevant software tools, open-source contributions, data science projects, or geospatial applications.

Selected applicants will be asked to present a past project for technical review.

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
